create_audioset_classes: create an AudiosetClasses instance to load AudioSet class labels and display names from a CSV cache file
lookup_class_index: use AudiosetClasses class2index method to convert a class string like a mid to its integer index
iterate_classes: iterate over an AudiosetClasses instance to get display names by index using getitem and len
create_audioset_dataset: create an AudioSet dataset instance with a subset name and optional video and audio clip parameters
access_audioset_metadata: access AudioSet properties like num_videos, num_classes, sample_id, root, and subset after initialization
